say:1:1530111001:1.text: We know you are our Herdmaster. The Wildborn are your people, and this land is yours.
say:1:1530111001:1.source_cn: 知道，你是兽群之主。雅库伯尔是你的子民，这片土地是你的土地。
say:1:1530111001:1.male: We know you are our Herdmaster. The Wildborn are your people, and this land is yours.
say:1:1530111001:1.female: We know you are our Herdmaster. The Wildborn are your people, and this land is yours.

say:2:1530111002:1.text: But right now, there's something even more pressing: we have to drive out the cunning Halians!
say:2:1530111002:1.source_cn: 但是，现在还有更重要的事——挫败阴险的呼临人！
say:2:1530111002:1.male: But right now, there's something even more pressing: we have to drive out the cunning Halians!
say:2:1530111002:1.female: But right now, there's something even more pressing: we have to drive out the cunning Halians!

say:3:1530111003:1.text: Great Herdmaster, lend your strength to the Wildborn!
say:3:1530111003:1.source_cn: 伟大的神，请先帮帮雅库伯尔！
say:3:1530111003:1.male: Great Herdmaster, lend your strength to the Wildborn!
say:3:1530111003:1.female: Great Herdmaster, lend your strength to the Wildborn!
